text: I don't hate you, you wish you were dead I'll just wait till the day is through And it's cry, cry, cryin' time for you You don't want me, that's okay Cause I know you'll be back someday Go ahead, try your luck When things get tough, start runnin' back again Oh I know, once again We'll be together hard till then Oh baby, it's a cryin' time
